Changes.note: The link you paste becomes the session's recording and is ready at once: the enrolled talebe and the course team see it under Ders kayıtları and on the watch page, and when it is Herkese açık everyone does while the course is not closed. If you chose a release time, talebe watch it from then on; the course team watches it at once. When the recording opens to talebe, the enrolled talebe get one “Kayıt eklendi” notification; it cannot be taken back and is not sent again when the recording changes later. Every change is written to the audit log. A recording cannot be deleted on this page, only changed; putting another link in place of a Bunny video deletes that video from Bunny for good.
